live_probe.response_summary: Array of time entry objects returned; path is a valid GET list endpoint
live_probe.interpretation: GET is fully supported at this path. A 200 does not confirm PUT exists — path serves GET (list) at minimum.

source_analysis.note: clockify_entries_update constructs 'paths.Workspace(wsID, "time-entries", entryID)' and calls Client.PutWithQuery — it does NOT use the user/{userId}/time-entries path for updates.
source_analysis.user_time_entries_path_usage: The user/{userId}/time-entries path is used by currentUserEntriesPath (entries.go:528) which feeds POST (timer start), PATCH (timer stop/update), DELETE (bulk delete), and GET (list). None of these call PUT.

conclusion: The path /workspaces/{wId}/user/{userId}/time-entries serves GET (list entries). No typed MCP tool issues PUT to this path. clockify_entries_update uses PUT /workspaces/{wId}/time-entries/{timeEntryId} instead. The PUT variant in the raw allowlist may reference an admin/bulk-update endpoint not exercised by any current typed tool. Path is GET-confirmed live; PUT existence is UNCONFIRMED by GET probe alone (GET returned 200, not 405, so cannot infer PUT support from this probe).
